_comment: UI metadata for sos_fade_generic, read by the command-center scanner. Labels and descriptions are the SOS Fade Pine input titles and tooltips VERBATIM wherever the setting is SOS Fade's own (docs/STRATEGY_WORKFLOW.md). UI ONLY: it never touches a trade decision. Click Scan Strategies after editing.

tldr.text: SOS Fade with everything but the core switched off, built to be run on other instruments.
A stop run past a recent high or low, or an RSI divergence, arms a side; then structure must shift the other way.
It rests a limit on the pullback into the same fib zone as SOS Fade, and only where there is a price gap.
It rests a limit on the pullback into the same fib zone as SOS Fade: on a gap when there is one, else at the 0.618.
The stop sits at the start of the move (the 1.0 fib). The whole trade closes at one target, at {exec_risk_pct}% risk, one trade at a time.

params.name: exec_arm_sweep
params.label: Arm on liquidity sweep
params.desc: Lets a run on the stops past a recent high or low start a setup.

params.name: exec_arm_div
params.label: Arm on RSI divergence
params.desc: Lets a momentum divergence start a setup. If this and the sweep trigger are both off, nothing ever trades.

params.name: aplus_window
params.label: Max time: sweep → SOS (minutes)
params.desc: How long a stop run stays valid while it waits for structure to confirm. 4320 = 3 days.

params.name: exec_longs
params.label: Trade longs
params.desc: Lets long setups trade. Off = shorts only.

params.name: exec_shorts
params.label: Trade shorts
params.desc: Lets short setups trade. Off = longs only.

params.name: exec_req_fvg
params.label: Require an FVG in the zone
params.desc: On = only trade when there is a gap in the pullback zone. Off = trade the pullback on its own.

params.name: exec_shift_entry
params.label: Enter on a 1m SOS then BOS
params.desc: On = no order rests in the zone. Once price tags the 0.5, the bot waits for a 1-minute SOS and then a BOS its way and buys or sells at market on the next minute. Cancelled if price touches the 1.0 or the 0.0 first. The gap setting is then ignored. Loads 1-minute bars, so runs are slower. Lab only — TradingView does not have it.

params.name: gen_target
params.label: Take profit at
params.desc: Where the whole position closes. Swing high/low = back to the far end of the move (the 0.0 fib). 1R, 2R, 3R = that many times what the trade is risking. The stop is always the 1.0 fib.

params.name: exec_risk_pct
params.label: Risk % per trade
params.desc: How much of the account each trade risks. The stop distance sets the position size, so a tighter stop buys a bigger position at the same risk.

params.name: exec_min_stop_mode
params.label: Minimum stop distance
params.desc: Skip a setup whose stop sits closer to the entry than the floor below.

params.name: exec_min_stop_val
params.label: Minimum stop floor (unit = mode above)
params.desc: The floor itself, in whatever unit the setting above uses. Higher refuses more setups.
